posts.cooked: I really considered getting the foils for both. But here's the conclusion I came to. If I got the foils of either I would most likely either not play with them or put them in sleeves to be played with, which would be more to pay for. I'd be pushing my limit to get the foil heroes, which I considered mainly just so something would come sooner than a year. Instead of paying the additional 60 dollars for those, I'll pay an additional 40ish dollars for the mini packs I don't have. I guess what it comes down to is, this game can milk you for whatever you want to put into it, just a matter of figuring what you want to prioritize if you can't or shouldn't get it all.
